linked_prs.title: fix(cli): preserve input history after /clear command
linked_prs.body:
## TLDR

Fixes #5876 - Separate input history management from chat history to prevent `/clear` command from dropping arrow key navigation entries.


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a9ee652d-3890-4679-8d09-ae2f85c1f309



## Dive Deeper

### Problem
The `/clear` command was clearing both chat history and input history because they were tightly coupled. When users executed `/clear`, they lost the ability to navigate through their previous inputs using arrow keys, which was an unintended side effect.

### Solution
Created an independent input history management system (`useInputHistoryStore`) that:
- Maintains input history separately from chat history
- Preserves the exact deduplication logic from the previous implementation
- Tracks past and current session messages independently
- Recalculates the entire history on each new input (matching previous behavior)
- Ensures `/clear` only affects chat history, not input history

### Key Implementation Details
1. **New Hook**: `useInputHistoryStore.ts` - Manages input history independently
2. **Deduplication Algorithm**: Ported the exact consecutive deduplication logic from the previous implementation
3. **Session Management**: Separates past session messages from current session messages
4. **Backward Compatibility**: Maintains all existing behavior except for the bug fix
